title: L'alibi
director: Adolfo Celi, Vittorio Gassman, Luciano Lucignani
writer: Adolfo Celi, Sandro Continenza, Vittorio Gassman
actors: Vittorio Gassman, Adolfo Celi, Luciano Lucignani
plot: Three friends meeting after the absence of one of them for 15 years out of the country. This sudden gathering give them the opportunity to examine their life, to criticize one another on their achievements.
